MewDirector* (Component* this) — the component of type 0x50c (= MewDirector) on the component's scene, else on the manager's main scene; NULL at the main menu of a dev launch (no director exists there). The dev-menu lambdas flag the director they get from it before entering TacticsTest.
void (TacticsTest* this, std::string* levelName, int, int, int) — registers the run console commands (bind, load, win, spawn, battle, …); reference only, never called by the harness.

MewDirector* global (DAT_1413dac30): set by MewDirector::init, which asserts "More than one mew director" when already set. A dev launch creates the test director (test00.sav) at boot, so it is non-null at the main menu; TacticsTest reads the director's settings.
void (MewDirector* this, std::string name) — opens/creates the save named by its argument (never pass a steamcampaign name); reference + witness host for the MewDirector global.

anchors.note: void (Component* c) — marks c's entity destroyed (+0x18), the scene dirty (+0x468), destroys child entities and every component (vtable +0x38, generation at ptr-8 bumped). The save-slot click (0x1c06c0) calls it on the current MewDirector before creating the new one, which is what lets MewDirector::init's "More than one mew director" check pass.

MewDirector* (Scene* scene, Entity* entity, std::string* saveName) — AddComponent<MewDirector> with the caller's save name (copied; the caller keeps ownership): MewDirector::init opens or creates that save. The save-slot click passes the slot's name; the harness passes only its own disposable slot.

void (MewDirector* d) — clears +0x78e, reads game_began / on_adventure / house_night from the save: new game -> 0x3af310 (a Cutscene scene with the intro driver 0x3c4130); resumed -> house (0x3c3ee0 on a House scene) or adventure (0x3bbff0). What the save-slot click calls after creating the director.

Node** (PropMap* map, Node** out16, std::string* key): the save property map lookup with insert (FNV-1a hash of the key; a 0x38-byte node, value at +0x30). The new-game branch 0x3af310 writes game_began = 1 through it on director+0x38; the harness does the same for enter Campaign house. The key is copied (the caller keeps it).
